## SECTION 2: THEME 25 ("THE WANTED LEVEL") FULL SPECIFICATION
Theme 25 is an open-world crime game pause-menu interface inspired by 80s neon synthwave and Vice City / Leonida aesthetic.
- Features:
  1. Persistent Heads-Up Display (GameHUD):
     - Left Operative Widget: Health bar (100%), Armor bar (77%), Energy badge (100), Active arsenal slot ('TYPESCRIPT // REACT 19').
     - Center Radio Widget: Interactive radio capsule cycling between 98.4 WAVE FM, 105.7 FLASH FM, 101.1 FEVER FM, and 94.5 EMOTION FM with audio tuning sound effect and equalizer animation.
     - Right Cash & Stars Widget: Dynamic cash odometer displaying $36,000,000 for 36 capitalized GitHub repositories, 1 to 5 interactive wanted heat stars with police siren sound effects, and ESC menu trigger.
     - Bottom-Right Quote: Display serif script quote '"Code is my weapon. Creativity is my world." — Prajwal'.
     - Bottom Marquee: 'VICE CITY INSPIRED • BUILD DIFFERENT • STAY LEGENDARY • PORTFOLIO COMPILATION V2.5'.
  2. Projects Showcase Page (`/projects` or `#projects`):
     - Top Left: 'PROJECTS:' uppercase bold sans with 'Case Studies' in italic pink script directly beneath.
     - Navigation:
       * Desktop: Left vertical column with 9 items, active item rendered as filled pink-purple gradient pill with animated chevron '>'.
       * Mobile: Sleek horizontal scrollable rail with instant 1-tap switching between sections.
     - Three Stacked Info Cards:
       * Card 1: Cyan border box with Project ID, Verified Deployment badge, title, tech stack badge icons, Completion %, Lines of Code, and 5-star rating.
       * Card 2: Pink border box with numbered feature bullets.
       * Card 3: 2x3 thumbnail gallery matrix and full-width pink pill button 'VIEW LIVE DEMO ›' wired to production URLs.
     - Tactical Radar:
       * Vector street grid with location pin and pink dashed route line.
       * 360-degree radar sweep beam.
       * Dynamic 'CURRENT OBJECTIVE' label matching per-project target locus.
     - Background: Full-bleed illustrated character working on architectural model with holographic tablet and neon cityscape outside, cleanly faded into #070912 void. Responsive with ambient opacity on mobile.
